description:
Ship the TLS ergonomic wrappers in pkix-chain that compose existing chain validation with the new pkix-identity hostname binding.

## Blocks on

- **PKIX-fmtv.7** (human-labeled): decides the v0.x wrapper set — specifically whether BOTH server and client wrappers ship, or only server, or both gated behind separate feature flags.
- **PKIX-fmtv.11.1**: pkix-identity `verify_dns_name` body must be implemented first so the wrappers have something to call.

## Deliverable

Add to pkix-chain public API:

```rust
pub fn verify_tls_server(
    chain:      &[Certificate],
    anchors:    &[TrustAnchor],
    name:       &ServerName<'_>,    // re-exported from pkix-identity
    policy:     &ValidationPolicy,  // typically BasicTlsProfile.policy(now)
    verifier:   &impl SignatureVerifier,
    revocation: &impl RevocationChecker,
) -> Result<ValidatedPath, VerifyError>;

pub fn verify_tls_client(
    chain:      &[Certificate],
    anchors:    &[TrustAnchor],
    identity:   Option<&ClientIdentity<'_>>,  // typically &MailboxName for rfc822 identity
    policy:     &ValidationPolicy,
    verifier:   &impl SignatureVerifier,
    revocation: &impl RevocationChecker,
) -> Result<ValidatedPath, VerifyError>;
```

Bodies:
1. `verify_chain(chain, anchors, policy, verifier, revocation)?` (existing).
2. `pkix_identity::verify_dns_name(&chain[0], name)?` (new, for server).
3. Optional identity binding for client (`pkix_identity::verify_mailbox` if `identity` is a `MailboxName` — requires PKIX-fmtv.12.1).
4. `Ok(ValidatedPath)`.

The server/client distinction is encoded in the caller-supplied `ValidationPolicy` (keyUsage / EKU id-kp-serverAuth vs id-kp-clientAuth — set via `BasicTlsProfile` or downstream profiles).

`ClientIdentity` shape is open; could be an enum over the few identity types TLS-client-auth typically uses (mailbox via rfc822Name SAN, DN via subject, custom otherName) — exact decision lives in PKIX-fmtv.7.

## VerifyError changes

Add variants `HostnameMismatch(IdentityError)`, `MalformedSan(IdentityError)` or similar, wrapping `pkix_identity::IdentityError`. Exact shape depends on PKIX-fmtv.7's decision.

## Tests

- Positive: cert with matching SAN + valid chain → `Ok(ValidatedPath)`.
- Identity-mismatch: cert with non-matching hostname + valid chain → `VerifyError::HostnameMismatch`.
- Chain-invalid: cert with matching SAN + broken chain → `VerifyError::PathInvalid` (existing).
- Path-validation runs first: cert with matching SAN + expired chain → path error, not identity error (assertion on error ordering).
- bettertls integration test through the wrapper (already pulled in by PKIX-fmtv.11.1, run a slice through verify_tls_server).

## Out of scope

- Body of `pkix_identity::verify_dns_name` — that is PKIX-fmtv.11.1.
- Wrapper-set decision — that is PKIX-fmtv.7.
- `verify_tls_client` body if PKIX-fmtv.7 decides server-only for v0.x — ship only `verify_tls_server` in that case.
title: pkix-chain: verify_tls_server / verify_tls_client wrappers (composes verify_chain + pkix_identity::verify_dns_name)
